newsitem.title: USA: USDA offers Egypt $200 mln under GSM-102 for FY97.
newsitem.headline: USDA offers Egypt $200 mln under GSM-102 for FY97.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Monday authorized $200 million in credit guarantees for sales of U.S. farm goods to Egypt under the Export Credit Guarantee Program (GSM-102) for fiscal year 1997.
USDA said exporters may apply for credit guarantees beginning Oct 1.

USDA allocated $99 million for a range of commodities including wheat, wheat flour, oilseeds, vegetable oils, protein meals, feed grains, wood products, dairy products, fresh fruit and animal feed products.
It allocated $1 million for breeder livestock.
The department said specific details on the remaining unallocated $100 million will be issued later.
Sales must be registered with USDA's Commodity Credit Corp by Sept. 30, 1997 and exporters' contractual arrangements must call for exports no later than Nov. 30, 1997, it said.
